prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the scene in Baytown, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the eastbound roadway with visible damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that Vehicle 2 was attempting to change lanes from the center lane into the right lane and made contact with the rear side of Vehicle 1. Driver 2 stated that Vehicle 1 had drifted toward the lane line just prior to contact. Both drivers stated that the contact was a sideswipe and that no airbags deployed. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and was evaluated on scene by medical personnel before declining transport. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 reported no injuries. Skid marks were not observed. Both vehicles were operable and were moved to the shoulder. Drivers exchanged insurance information. Citations were not issued at the scene pending further review.
